versions.changelog: Add feishu-cli discovery aliases and search tags.

Initial release of lark-cli-devhub-docs-wiki.

- Provides guidelines for organizing Feishu Wiki spaces and Docs for development knowledge hubs.
- Recommends a Wiki structure with suggested first-level pages (Inbox, Projects, Bugfix Retros, Playbooks, Decisions, Maps, Archive).
- Lists page management practices: every page should have a Base record, with key details kept in Base for indexing and retrieval.
- Includes command-line examples for creating Docs and Wiki nodes with lark-cli.
- Advises on when to use related official skills for advanced features.
